outputContract: Amara Unfold Open Event Schema v1 Markdown with YAML frontmatter

adapters.label: Photo and video metadata
adapters.nextStep: Extract timestamps, dimensions, device, GPS, hashes, and provenance into one open Markdown event per media file.

adapters.label: Photo metadata Markdown
adapters.nextStep: Validate the Markdown substrate and keep it portable; do not extract it again.

adapters.label: Apple Music track metadata
adapters.nextStep: Create a Markdown track catalog plus daily Timeline summaries from explicit Date Added only. Last Played remains catalog metadata.

adapters.label: Apple Music local library
adapters.format: Music.app library metadata (one-time read) or local audio folder
adapters.nextStep: Create separate track and playlist Markdown catalogs with playlist membership. Timeline uses explicit track Date Added only; Last Played and loose audio-file timestamps never become Timeline dates.

adapters.label: Apple Music Markdown library
adapters.nextStep: Validate and map the existing Markdown into the canonical music substrate; do not rebuild the library from pixels or proprietary storage.

adapters.label: Airbnb data export
adapters.nextStep: Normalize every reservation status plus readable messages and reviews; inspect every JSON category and record exact reasons for anything deliberately kept out of Timeline.

adapters.label: Banking Takeout
adapters.nextStep: Recognize transaction columns, preserve every row in readable daily movement files, and add a compact monthly overview.

adapters.label: Banking Takeout
adapters.nextStep: Recognize flexible comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe transaction columns, preserve every row in readable daily movement files, and add a compact monthly overview.

adapters.label: Word diary
adapters.nextStep: Read Word headings and verbatim paragraphs locally, preserving document order and heading-level date precision.

adapters.label: Apple Mail exported mailbox
adapters.nextStep: Read an Apple Mail exported mailbox locally and emit one cleaned email Markdown event per message.

adapters.label: Apple Calendar local calendars
adapters.nextStep: Read local iCalendar events and emit dated timeline Markdown with summary, location, organizer, attendees, and provenance.

adapters.label: Apple Contacts local cards
adapters.nextStep: Read local vCards and emit people/contact Markdown with names, organizations, birthdays, contact fields, and provenance; note bodies are not emitted by default.

adapters.label: Google Photos takeout
adapters.format: ZIP bundle with media and supplemental JSON
adapters.nextStep: Read supplemental metadata directly inside the ZIP and emit photo events without copying media.

adapters.label: Gmail takeout
adapters.nextStep: Stream MBOX messages directly from the ZIP and emit open email events without an online mail account.

adapters.label: YouTube and YouTube Music takeout
adapters.nextStep: Normalize YouTube CSV rows such as subscriptions or history into portable web events.

adapters.label: Google Maps
adapters.nextStep: Read Google Maps takeouts, standalone KMZ files, KMZ folders, saved-place CSV collections, or saved-places JSON locally and preserve the detected input format as provenance.
